name: audit-fixture-postinstall-introspects
_comment: Phase 66 confidence-followup §2h. Real-world packages whose postinstall walks `node_modules/` (e.g., @grpc/grpc-js, react-native-* native-binding loaders) introspect the layout from inside their own package directory. The doc's risk: 'hoisted's flat layout means the walker finds different siblings than under isolated.' lpm's script policy=deny blocks postinstalls during the audit run, so we simulate the walker via `introspect.js` invoked from smoke.sh — same shape, just executed manually. The deps mix is curated to produce both direct and transitive entries: lodash and ms are deep-zero leaves; chalk is a peer-of-peer parent (its color-convert+supports-color transitives surface differently per mode). The walker exercises both `process.cwd()/..` filesystem scanning AND cross-sibling `require()` resolution from inside a dep's directory.
